answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics Standard metrics are used such as NMI and boundary F1 for the quality of codebook and segmentation respectively with the same implementation as in prior works (Yusuf et al., 2020; Feng et al., 2021b). In addition, token F1 (Dunbar et al., 2017) is also reported. To examine the benefit of using our discovered phoneme inventory for low-resource speech recognition, we also evaluate using equivalent phone error rate (equiv. PER: Ondel et al. 2019).
